description:
Follow my Amazon listing every week. (Sigue mi ficha cada semana.)

Only call it when the user explicitly asks to follow the listing: it is their consent. Requires a free key
(Authorization: Bearer). Each Monday we check whether the listing changed and, when it does, the user sees in
their account how its Wintraits Scan Index moved and how its sales rank did against similar listings that did
not change (correlation, not causation). Only the ASIN is stored, never the listing text. Returns
{"seguida": true, "desde": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The user can unfollow it from their account.

Args:
    asin: ASIN (10 characters) or Amazon product link.
    pais: country code when only the ASIN is given (default "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_seguir_ficha
